evals.prompt: Investiga este email sospechoso de phishing que me llego (tengo el header completo, doy consentimiento)
evals.expected_output: Plan por fases con comandos aprobados, veredicto y reporte estructurado
expectations: Confirms authorization and scope before running any command
Produces a phased plan with concrete commands and waits for approval
Ends with a phishing verdict and a structured report

evals.prompt: Due diligence sobre esta empresa antes de firmar contrato: dominio, registros y presencia
evals.expected_output: Reporte OSINT con hallazgos verificados y nivel de confianza
expectations: Covers domain, registry and public presence
Separates verified findings from inferences and states confidence
Produces a structured report usable for a contract decision

evals.prompt: Verifica si este numero de telefono es legitimo (es del supuesto banco que me llamo)
evals.expected_output: Parseo con phone parser + veredicto de legitimidad
expectations: Runs the phone parser before interpreting the number
Reports carrier, line type and region from the parsed data
Gives a legitimacy verdict with its evidence and stated limits
